answer: The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in walnut, expire in signal, and dune lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 67 aliases therefore needs 171 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4470 identities would post 1682 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
